jobs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / faithful product localization. Create a single square English e-commerce product image for the EXACT pink bubble-concentrate sachets in the supplied reference. Preserve the pink flat sealed foil packet shape, crimped edges, bubble motifs, printed "BUBBLE", "CONCENTRATE", elephant mark, "BUBBLE STORY", and actual small original Chinese packaging print (do not translate or redesign the physical packaging). Preserve the package as the customer's actual item, not a newly invented brand or bottle. Use a crisp photorealistic fan of the five sample sachets as in the reference, on a clean warm ivory background, soft realistic shadows, restrained rose-pink headings with ample margins. The five shown packets are a product illustration; do not imply their visible count is the ordered quantity. Add a small note "Product illustration" unobtrusively. No bubble machine, other accessories, bottles, batteries, children, watermarks, prices or invented safety/non-toxic/performance/dilution-ratio claims. Readable English promotional text outside packaging only. Exact copy: headline "BUBBLE MACHINE REFILL"; subheading "Concentrate sachets"; option line "Choose 10, 30 or 50 sachets"; footer "Refill liquid only • Machine not included". Product fan centered beneath headline, all five sample packets fully visible with clear front packet. One square image.
